caption: The drawing depicts a brown, teardrop-shaped flask with a metal cap and neck piece at the top. The cap appears cylindrical with a notch at the top, and a small metal ring or loop is attached to one side of the neck. The body of the flask is decorated with a raised design, featuring a large tree at the center with visible branches and leaves. Below the tree, a person is shown reclining on the ground, appearing to rest against the tree trunk. There is another smaller object depicted on the ground near the figure. On the left side of the tree, a deer or similar animal is hanging by its hind legs, while on the right side of the tree, there is a rectangular object, possibly a bag or satchel, hanging from a branch. The background is a plain off-white or beige, and the object is rendered in shades of brown, with some black and darker brown used for shading, giving a three-dimensional appearance. The overall composition is centrally focused on the flask, with ample space around it on the page.
title: Powder Flask
